headline: Jensen Huang will testify before the U.S. Congress on December 1 over Nvidia scandal
summary: Former Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang will appear before three US House of Representatives committees on December 1 to testify on the scandal over chip exports to China.
why: Nvidia designs the GPUs used in AI data centers, and US export controls on advanced chips to China directly affect its sales and regulatory risk.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Congressional scrutiny of chip exports to China bears on the company's regulatory exposure and China sales.
